messages:
zahra: Heads-up — seeing a sharp tail latency spike in prod right after yesterday's scheduler admission tweak. p95 went from ~80ms -> ~420ms for text-gen workloads. Anyone else seeing this?
kevin: on it, can you post the grafana link and a rough timeframe?
zahra: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/serving/runtime — spike starts 2026-03-18T10:11Z, p50 fine, p95/p99 huge. correlates with higher microbatching and increased kv_cache evictions.
maya: checked a few node logs, there are repeated lines like `fallback_to_reference_kernel` around the same timestamps.
eli: if kernel fallback + KV evictions line up that's a likely perf path. can you paste runtime profiler snippets?
zahra: pasted profiler excerpt below:
```
2026-03-18T10:12:03Z kernel_selector: picked f32_kernel for seq_len=1..64
2026-03-18T10:12:03Z kernel_selector: fallback_to_reference_kernel for layer 6 (quant mismatch)
2026-03-18T10:12:04Z kv_cache: evict shard 17 (pressure=0.84)
2026-03-18T10:12:05Z scheduler: microbatch_size=32 -> 128 (autoscale)
```
kevin: that sequence smells like: scheduler pushes microbatch size up (to hit throughput), longer seqs + bigger batches -> kv cache hotset grows -> eviction -> subsequent requests miss KV -> kernel selector sees degraded quant/shape cache and falls back to slower kernels. tail latency explodes.
maya: also saw admission-control oscillation in the same window: it bumped queue depth, then rapidly dropped, causing microbatch sizes to oscillate — worsens cache churn.
sre-bot: Incident created INC-2026-042 by zahra
eli: proposed immediate mitigations: 1) revert admission threshold tweak to previous values, 2) cap microbatch at 64 for now, 3) enable aggressive KV-cache preservations (pin recent shards), 4) add alert for kernel-fallback rate > 0.5%.
kevin: preparing rollback PR now: `git checkout main && git revert <commit-sha> && ./ci/deploy --env=prod --stage=canary`
maya: also recommend a short-term kernel-selector safety: if fallback rate > 1% in 1m, force pin to the last-known-good kernel variant for 5m and notify infra.
infra-bot: Deploy triggered: canary rollout to 10% hosts (job: deploy-190123-rollback)
zahra: canary metrics look positive after rollback — p95 back down to ~90ms within ~2m. continuing to monitor.
eli: follow-ups for postmortem: 1) add microbatch-size histogram metric, 2) emit kv_cache eviction rate per shard, 3) trace kernel-selection decision path in profiler traces, 4) add unit/regression test for sequence-length + concurrency causing eviction.
kevin: opened RFC issue RFC-3422: "scheduler backpressure heuristics + kernel-selector coordination" and linked incident graph.
maya: also adding an e2e stress test in perf lab that simulates long sequences + high qps to validate cache stability and prevent future oscillations.
zahra: nice work everyone. I'll update the incident doc and tag infra/rt-runtime for the postmortem. :thumbsup:
kevin: thanks — will follow up on the kernel-selector quick fix and alerts.
